I answered Pree in her DM: her standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team, for the Thistle rollout, is Fridays at 11:15. She told me this herself in the same DM on Oct 14 and said it applied from then on. Because it came from her own DM, it was fine to share with her.

My first reply got the day wrong. It said today's call was at 11:15, but Oct 17, 2026 is a Saturday. I posted a correction right after: no call today, and the next one is Friday, Oct 23 at 11:15.

The call isn't on any calendar I can see, so I offered to set up an invite. I haven't created anything or changed her calendar.
